On a lake with more kinds of fish than any other, the one that fills Malawi's dinner plates is silver, plain and about as long as your finger, and when the moon is full the fishermen's lamps can't compete with it. 🌕🐟
Do you keep aquarium fish at home? If any of them came from Lake Malawi, tell us which ones.
